name: Performance Foodservice - Southern California (City of Industry)

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via Street View — building carries the red 'PERFORMANCE foodservice' logo on the west face along Gale Ave. Address 16639 Gale Ave, City of Industry CA; coord cross-checked against LoopNet/assessor parcel 8242-011-065/067 (~34.00485,-117.94161). Roster 'movedMeters 1352' is a stale-geocode artifact — rooftop coord is accurate.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View clearly shows a blue sliding gate spanning the truck driveway off Gale Ave, with chain-link perimeter fencing and a 'VISITOR' parking sign by the office. Controlled truck entrance confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure visible at the gate; entrance area is partly tree-shaded in satellite but Street View shows no booth — access is gate-only.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no shack — kiosk/call-box/app check-in implied. true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock bank on the east face of the DC with trailers backed in; ~50+ doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop stalls in the yard east of the building; ~25-50 trailers.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Tight, fully built-out urban industrial parcel; the gate apron has little spare width for an express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense City of Industry industrial corridor — Urban.
